exact_locators.supported_observation: The article evaluates earlier claims that Mundari lacks stable word classes and states that the analysis uses Hoffmann's corpus together with substantial new data, including a large lexical sample.
The authors report their article-level conclusion that Mundari has definable word classes, including open noun and verb classes and a closed adjective class, while noting productive predicative uses.
ANU marks the repository manifestation Open Access and lists a downloadable PDF named 01_Evans_Mundari:_The_myth_of_a_2005.pdf at 234.31 KB.
